My dear [Mrs Elgie](/person/475)
Many thanks for this dear little note. I always did think your Girls most thoroughly good and conscientious, and I think their love of home is the best and happiest thing for the place and people. I wonder when those lawyers will finish off and let you take possession.[^1] I hope it is all right about [Helena Dugay](/person/447)
your affectionate

C M Yonge


[^1]: Perhaps of the new incumbency of Otterbourne, so that the [Rev. Walter Elgie](/person/478) became Vicar rather than curate.
